LESSON: SARUFI 15.4.1 USEMI HALISI NA USEMI WA TAARIFA

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: Strand 15
Topic 15.4: Sarufi 15.4.1 Usemi Halisi na Usemi wa Taarifa

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Sarufi 15.4.1 Usemi Halisi na Usemi wa Taarifa. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kutambua usemi halisi na usemi wa taarifa katika matini
2. kujadili kanuni za kubadilisha usemi halisi kuwa usemi wa taarifa kwa kuzingatia kanuni za kubadilisha usemi
3. kutumia usemi halisi na usemi wa taarifa ifaavyo
4. Kumakinikia jinsi mwanafunzi anavyotumia lugha katika mawasiliano

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kutambua usemi halisi na usemi wa taarifa katika matini
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua usemi halisi na usemi wa taarifa katika matini. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kujadili kanuni za kubadilisha usemi halisi kuwa usemi wa taarifa kwa kuzingatia kanuni za kubadilisha usemi
   In simple words: practise until you can kujadili kanuni za kubadilisha usemi halisi kuwa usemi wa taarifa kwa kuzingatia kanuni za kubadilisha usemi. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. kutumia usemi halisi na usemi wa taarifa ifaavyo
   In simple words: practise until you can kutumia usemi halisi na usemi wa taarifa ifaavyo. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

4. Kumakinikia jinsi mwanafunzi anavyotumia lugha katika mawasiliano
   In simple words: practise until you can kumakinikia jinsi mwanafunzi anavyotumia lugha katika mawasiliano. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Sarufi 15.4.1 Usemi Halisi na Usemi wa Taarifa using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Sarufi 15.4.1 Usemi Halisi na Usemi wa Taarifa in the examples.
2. Explain Sarufi 15.4.1 Usemi Halisi na Usemi wa Taarifa to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Sarufi 15.4.1 Usemi Halisi na Usemi wa Taarifa.
4. Show that you can: kutambua usemi halisi na usemi wa taarifa katika matini

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Sarufi 15.4.1 Usemi Halisi na Usemi wa Taarifa using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Sarufi 15.4.1 Usemi Halisi na Usemi wa Taarifa important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kutambua usemi halisi na usemi wa taarifa katika matini
2. kujadili kanuni za kubadilisha usemi halisi kuwa usemi wa taarifa kwa kuzingatia kanuni za kubadilisha usemi
3. kutumia usemi halisi na usemi wa taarifa ifaavyo
4. Kumakinikia jinsi mwanafunzi anavyotumia lugha katika mawasiliano

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
